title: Manatee County Commission, District 4
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Republican primary result per Suncoast News Network; November opponent (if any) not verified.

candidates.name: Mike Rahn
candidates.occupation: Residential mortgage lender; Manatee County commissioner (District 4) since 2022
candidates.background: Republican Mike Rahn is a lifelong Manatee/Sarasota resident and U.S. Marine Corps veteran who served in Operation Desert Storm, and has worked in residential mortgage lending for more than 35 years. He is a former president of the Manatee-Sarasota Building Industry Association and former vice chair of the county Planning Commission. Elected in November 2022, he chaired the commission in 2024 and won the August 2026 primary with 67.5%; he faces a write-in candidate in November.

environment.summary: Voted in October 2023 with the 5-1 majority to cut the county's wetland buffer requirements to the state minimum, saying he trusted state standards; in April 2025 he cast the lone vote against transmitting a plan amendment to restore the larger local buffers, citing state law (SB 250).
environment.quote: I'm a huge fan of protecting our environment, protecting our watersheds and doing the things we need to do to make sure our kids and grandkids have safe drinking water

sources.title: Manatee County votes to cut local wetland protections in favor of developer interests - Bradenton Herald (via Yahoo News)

growth.summary: Cast the lone vote on Sept. 2, 2025 against joining the lawsuit challenging SB 180, the state law limiting local development restrictions, preferring to lobby for changes. In August 2024 he voted for a 50% phased impact-fee increase but opposed delaying it to pursue a larger increase, arguing developers pass fees on to buyers.
growth.quote: We can join this lawsuit at any time
